turns.text: Hi, hmm, I want to change my flight to Mumbai. To a morning one, actually...
Sure. May I have your booking code and last name first?
Thanks, Ms. Mendes. I see SK510 on Thursday at 07:45 on a Flex fare. Which flight would you like?
A morning one, hmm, actually, no, can I do the evening?
The evening flight is SK512 at 21:00. Which day would you like?
Same day, I guess. Actually, hmm, can you just cancel the whole thing?
I can cancel it. Since it's a voluntary cancellation, you'd get a travel credit rather than a refund. Would you like me to go ahead?
Hmm, a credit, not money? Actually, no, wait, don't cancel. Keep the evening one.
No problem, I haven't cancelled anything. Moving to SK512 on Thursday at 21:00 is free on Flex, and the fare is 190 dollars against your 210, so there's no extra charge. Shall I book it?
Yes, hmm, yes please, the evening.
All set. You're now on SK512 Thursday at 21:00 with no fee. Anything else?
No, that's it, thank you. Bye!
